content2.content: Being connected to a Wi-Fi network doesn't guarantee internet access (e.g., a router without an uplink). To confirm real internet access, you must ping a reliable server.

content4.content: You can use Dart's built-in `InternetAddress.lookup` to check if a domain can be resolved.

content7.content: For a more robust solution, use the `internet_connection_checker_plus` package, which handles timeouts and multiple checks automatically.

content11.content: Always distinguish between network connectivity (Wi-Fi/Mobile connected) and actual internet access (can reach server) to provide accurate feedback to the user.
